Earning $10,000 per month from streaming alone puts you in the top tier of independent musicians. At Spotify's average rate, that means roughly 2.5 million monthly streams, which implies either a large, active fanbase or one or more tracks with major viral or playlist momentum.

The $1,000 Monthly Milestone

At Spotify's average rate, that requires about 250,000 monthly streams, which implies a real and engaged listener base. Across all platforms combined, you might be hitting 150,000-300,000 total monthly streams depending on your platform distribution.
